title: Parameterized naturality of evaluation on an arrow family
statement:
Use quasicategories, right-pinched mapping spaces and coherent transformations of [def-cbc-enhanced-diagrams-cones], and the coherent nerve $\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ of Kan complexes of [def-coef-infinity-category-of-spaces]. All objects fit in fixed containing universes. Let $C$ be a $\mathcal W$-small quasicategory, $F,G:C\to\mathcal S_{\mathcal W}$ coherent functors, $a\in C$ and $\eta\in F(a)$ a vertex. Put $T=\operatorname{Map}_{\operatorname{Fun}(C,\mathcal S_{\mathcal W})}(F,G)$ and $M_x=\operatorname{Map}^{R}_C(a,x)$. Let $j_x:M_x\times\Delta^1\to C$ be the right-pinch arrow family of [lem-coef-infinity-pinch-comparison]. Apply $F$ to $j_x$ and precompose with $\eta$ to form a coherent cocone $\Delta_{M_x}*\to\Delta_{M_x}F(x)$; denote its point map by $e^F_{\eta,x}:M_x\to F(x)$, up to homotopy, using the point-family equivalence of [lem-coef-space-point-cocone-criterion]. Evaluation of transformations and the analogous $G$-action give two maps, interpreted through that same point-family equivalence,
$$T\times M_x\longrightarrow G(x),\qquad (\alpha,f)\longmapsto\alpha_x(e^F_{\eta,x}(f)),\qquad (\alpha,f)\longmapsto G(f)(\alpha_a(\eta)).$$
These maps are simplicially homotopic. The homotopy is compatible with all simplicial parameters of the coherent transformation and arrow families: for every simplicial parameter $B\to T$, it restricts to the corresponding homotopy on $B\times M_x$, with all faces, degeneracies and higher naturality compatibilities in $x$ retained by internal evaluation on $C$. No representability or invertibility hypothesis on $e^F_{\eta,x}$, and no Yoneda evaluation equivalence, is assumed.
